docs(arc42): listing targets and eval assistants

## Intent

The listing scenario and the evals need concrete targets and named assistants.

## Key changes

- qs-first-listings: half of the listing pull requests pass validation on the first run, 7 of 8 on the second after a comment with the check results.
- The "other assistant" scenario requires Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI to pass, run by hand on their latest models.
- The plan records the results comment (KD-10) and that there is no automated eval pipeline (KD-14).
